summary: J-Star Holding, a Taiwan-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an October 29, 2026 Class Meeting of Class A holders and an Extraordinary General Meeting, the US equivalent of a special shareholder meeting. Class A holders approved (87.73% for) increasing Class B voting rights from ten to fifty votes per share, subject to Class B consent. The EGM approved seven items, including raising authorized capital from US$300 million to US$2.5 billion via 880 million new Class A shares. No transaction, price, or board recommendation stated; watch for dilution and governance implications.
